Level.title: Level
Level.description: How sure a check is when it matches.

oneOf.description: The code is certain the line breaks the rule, such as a real access key. An error always counts as a finding.
The line might break the rule, and might be a false alarm. The agent reads it and decides. A warning never fails anything until the agent confirms it.

Result.description: One result, from a code check or from the agent. The standard output.
Result.title: Result

ReviewTask.description: One task for the agent: read a file, or the whole skill, against rules.
ReviewTask.title: ReviewTask

RuleId.title: RuleId
RuleId.description: Every rule the engine knows. Each is defined once, in the rule file of its type.

oneOf.description: Lines that override instructions, hide a step from the user, change the agent's role, claim prior approval, or speak to a reviewer.
Steps that send, post, upload, or save the user's content somewhere the description doesn't need.
Links whose domain doesn't fit the purpose, or that the agent fetches and follows at run time.
Steps that bypass a security control, run commands or programs, or change system settings.
Advice that would weaken someone's security if they followed it.
Packages the sandbox doesn't provide, install steps, or code pulled from somewhere that can change.
Tools the workflows don't use or the purpose doesn't need, and changes made without the user's confirmation.
Anything that hides what the skill does: hidden text, encoded strings, unreadable files, or a description that doesn't match the workflows.
Steps that chain tools to reach systems the purpose doesn't need.
Steps that write to memory or files later conversations read, to change how the agent behaves next time.
Real credentials, personal data, or account details in the files, or steps that collect personal data the purpose doesn't need.
SKILL.md frontmatter has the required fields, each in a valid format.
SKILL.md has the headings save_skill requires.
The SKILL.md body stays under the line limit, since every line loads on every run.
The SKILL.md body prose has no em dashes or emojis.
Protects the user from a skill that could harm them: sending data out, hiding instructions, or running what it shouldn't.
Checks that the skill follows the Skill Architect standard, so it is consistent, testable, and maintainable.
One task per file: the agent reads the whole file against the rule.
One task for the whole skill, such as comparing the description with the workflows.
A code check in a rule file produced the result.
The agent produced the result while reading a file or answering a review task.
The check ran on the whole skill and found nothing.
A warning the agent hasn't judged yet. A review with an open result is incomplete.
A finding: an error, or a warning or agent result the agent judged to break the rule.
A warning the agent judged to be a false alarm, with the reason. It stays in the results so anyone can see what was filtered out.
The agent can't decide and asks the user. After the user answers, it becomes confirmed or dismissed.

NoMatch.title: NoMatch
NoMatch.description: What a frontmatter_value check does when its extract pattern finds no value.

oneOf.description: Report nothing: another check covers a missing or unquoted value.
Report the check as failed, since the value is in the wrong format.

Target.title: Target
Target.description: Which part of a text file a text check reads.

oneOf.description: The whole text of the file.
Only the YAML frontmatter of SKILL.md.
The SKILL.md body with fenced code blanked out, keeping line numbers.

CheckKind.title: CheckKind
CheckKind.description: Every kind of code check the engine can run. A rule file chooses a kind and gives its parameters; the engine owns how each kind works.

oneOf.description: Flags every match of a regular expression in the target text, minus matches the exclude pattern finds.
Flags every HTML comment, since an agent reads text a person doesn't see.
Flags lines with invisible or control characters that can hide text.
Flags a run of blank lines that can push text out of sight.
Flags a line longer than the limit, where text can hide past the edge of the screen.
Flags public IPv4 addresses, leaving out private and documentation ranges.
Flags files whose suffix or name is on the list.
Flags hidden files and cache folders.
Flags symbolic links and paths that escape the skill folder.
Flags an image file whose bytes don't match its suffix.
Flags a text file that contains binary data.
Flags files whose suffix isn't on the known list.
Flags a skill with more files than the limit.
Flags a file larger than the limit.
Flags a SKILL.md with no frontmatter, frontmatter that doesn't parse, or a custom YAML tag.
Flags frontmatter tools that no workflow's tools=[...] names.
Flags Python imports of the listed modules.
Flags Python imports outside the standard library and the skill's own modules.
Flags Python calls to the listed functions.
Flags yaml.load without a safe loader.
Flags Python that doesn't parse, since unparsed code can't be reviewed.
Flags JavaScript imports of the listed modules.
Flags JavaScript imports outside the listed Node.js modules.
Passes when SKILL.md frontmatter has the field.
When the field is present, passes if its value matches the pattern, length limit, or allowed values.
Passes when the SKILL.md body contains the heading.
Passes when the SKILL.md body is within the line limit.
Passes when no body prose line matches the pattern.
